duplicate_groups.basis: Both ask 03*A9 in GF(2^8) reduced by x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1. All four binary byte choices agree under permutation; independent result E0 (11100000).

Same SAI predicate and four complete propositions: supplementary (2/n)=+1 at residues 1,7; 11 claimed a square modulo17; Jacobi(158,235)=-1; roots of4 modulo21. The incorrect proposition is the claim about11/17, not just a shared topic.

All four ECB/CBC/OFB propositions correspond exactly. The independent theory review leaves the CBC whole-message versus individual-block wording unresolved. Both keys are null; identical missing keys do not establish a common unique correct content. Final full A-D extension review adds2021/12 with reference mappingA->D,B->A,C->C,D->B. Its CBC statement differs only by a comma, including the same key/IV/first-block qualifiers. The same conditional interpretation is unresolved in all three; extension does not authorize collapse.

Same authentication question and same integrity/origin/nonrepudiation/all choices. Whether nonrepudiation is part of message authentication depends on course-wide versus standard scope. A unique correct content is not established. Final full A-D review addsK16-2/36: mau tin/ban tin both mean the message, and source 'Khong choi tu ban goc' names the origin nonrepudiation objective in the same broad course-authentication interpretation. The independent source-specific theory rows have the same incomplete truth vector(true,true,unknown,unknown) and identical standard/course conditional answers. No unique correctness equivalence is promoted. K16-3/2038 is not included because its four options combine different pairs of objectives.
Both ask which option is not a generator modulo41, with precisely {7,12,11,3}. Orders are40,40,40,8; the shared correct content is3.
All four options are the same four equations a*b=b, a*e=a, a*b=a, a*b=e. Stems request the inverse condition with identity e; only a*b=e defines the requested inverse in the documented group context.
Both request phi(969), with exactly the choices288,567,304,576. Independent factorization/totient gives576.
Both ask log base17 of15 modulo97, with the complete exponent set31,17,10,13. Independent power checking selects31.
Same coprime-pair request and all four ordered pairs (117,391),(391,153),(85,187),(85,255); gcds1,17,17,85. Shared correct pair is(117,391).
After the reviewed source correction from50 to20 in 2021/6, both ask ord_20(17), with the same choices8,4,1,2. Independent order is4; the old50 reading is not used.

Same NOT-correct request; every option matches: sender private-key signing, private-key encryption for confidentiality, symmetric one-key model, block/stream classification. Only the private-key confidentiality claim is incorrect in both.

Same SAI stem and same four hash propositions, including the exact variable-output-length false claim. Other options state fixed digest, computational one-wayness and non-bijection. Correct content is the variable-length claim, independently reviewed in theory audit.

Same true-claim request with CA as trusted issuer, CA binding entity to public key, entity public-key registration and all-of-the-above. All three individual propositions match; conventional aggregate is the same full conjunction, not merely the text 'all'.

Same question asks what is NOT a CA certificate creation step. Full four-option set is entity-private-key signing, entity public-key registration, CA signing, CA binding entity and key. Correct content is the entity-private-key issuer-signature claim, distinct from signing a CSR.
Same maximum-of-GCD request with all four operands (137,479),(130,315),(42,286),(281,389). Values1,5,2,1; shared correct content GCD(130,315).

Same SAI stem and all four full public-key propositions after permutation. Independent theory has a complete truth vector: replacement and 'difficulty proved' claims are both false. Their correct-content SETS agree, but there is no common unique answer; never collapse this potential group.
Same plaintext Squid game, seed sun and plaintext-autokey convention; all four ciphertext options match under permutation. Independent output KKHATAIPK.

Both encrypt FRIDAY to ADDHOM with Hill m=2 and row vectors A=0..Z=25. All four 2x2 matrices are identical under the recorded option permutation. Directly inspected both reviewed figures; numeric output selects [[3,8],[19,7]]. No decryption-key or Monday/OBJZMA variant is included.

Both evaluate DES S1 on110101, with all four binary outputs0011,1110,1011,0101. Both complete reviewed figures were opened and all64 S1 entries agree. Row3,column10 gives0011; standard-table wording versus displayed table adds no condition.

Same a=75,p=97,nonresidue b=5, requested end of i=1 and same exact d/r/c algorithm. Opened both reviewed algorithm figures; update order and exponent2^(s-i-1) agree. All four triples correspond; independent result(d,r,c)=(1,96,8).

Same KSA initialization S[i]=i,j=0,T[0]=13,T[1]=27 and iteration i=1 Swap. Opened both complete algorithm/choice figures. Every sparse S-array distractor matches after permutation; independent final swaps are(0,13),(1,41).

Opened both reviewed figures: all32 C bits, all32 P indices, all fixed output bits and all7 blank positions match. C=10010111111011001001011101010110; zero-based blank indices5,6,14,15,16,26,27. All four seven-bit options match after permutation. Independent missing bits0111011. K16-2/27 has a different blank mask and is expressly excluded.

Same27^101 mod211 and identical full four-row table i=0..6, including shown A/b values and six blank cells(bit5,bit6,A5,A6,b5,b6). Opened both new figures. All six-tuples/distractors correspond; independent result(1,1,109,65,115,90). Caption lengths/question numbers are not mathematical differences.

Same curve y^2=x^3+x+6 overF11, G=(2,7), private scalar3 and public-point request. All four point choices(8,8),(10,2),(5,9),(8,3) match. Numeric inputs and independent multiplication agree at(8,3); scalar2 and G=(7,2) variants are excluded.

Same curve overF11, G=(7,2),k=2,public P_A=(5,2),given kP_A=(10,2),message point(3,6), and ordered-pair ciphertext request. Full four ciphertext-pair options match. Independent result[(2,7),(10,9)] in both.

All ask the best correct DES key-schedule statement. All four choices match: the same erroneous two-bit round list, same erroneous one-bit list1,2,6,16, correct64-bit input/PC-1/rotate/PC-2 description and all-of-the-above. C_i,D_i versus C,D denotes the same two halves. The reviewed correction of2021/4(B) to1,2,6,16 is essential.

Opened both complete figures: identical AES standard coefficient matrix and full state[[63,EB,9F,A0],[2F,93,92,C0],[AF,C7,AB,30],[A2,20,CB,2B]], zero-based targetx21. Same full hex option set{F4,32,8D,7A}; independent result8D. AT17/7 has different distractors06 and92 and is excluded despite the same8D result.

After source correction K16-3/2027 is modulo20, exactly as K16-2/5. Same request ord_20(13), full choice multiset{4,1,2,8}; independent result4. Neither ord_20(17) nor a modulo50 question is substituted.

Same true-proposition request with exactly the three statements about recipient keys for confidentiality, sender keys for signing, and combining signing with encryption. All-of-the-above covers the same three statements; conventional aggregateD agrees with independent theory. The SAI question K16-3/2021 has a hash/confidentiality distractor and is excluded.

Same three hash definitions and same all-of-the-above question. In2021/5(B), reviewed source equality h(x)=h(x') has been restored; both second-preimage statements now have x'!=x and equal digests. All three true definitions correspond; the aggregate conjunctionD is equivalent.

Same sequence(15,47,67,130,287), claimed superincreasing property, general exhaustive complexityO(2^n), greedy complexityO(n) and same all-of-the-above. The terms balo/ba lo are the same named subset-sum problem. Independent prefix sums/operation reasoning confirm all three; conventionalD matches. Sequence240 and the SAI K16-3/2040 question are excluded.

Same true-proposition request and exactly the three claims: cyclic iff it has a generator, element order divides phi(n), and orderphi(n) means generator ofZ_n*. The notation 'thuoc' versus membership symbol does not change a quantified domain. Same aggregate conjunctionD; generator-count-phi(n) false-claim variants are excluded.

Same p=211,alpha=41,a=117,k=33,m=56, TRUE predicate and complete four statements (private33,cipher(28,192),public beta89,all). Private-key notation aliases k_d/k_A do not change the asserted role. Independent true content set is{cipher(28,192),beta89}; no unique answer, so potential only. K16-3/2047 changes/swaps actual statements and is excluded.

Same p=199,q=211,m=1234, TRUE request and all four propositions including the identical erroneous root claim explicitly referring to m=1731. Independent c=11152 and roots[1234,14169,27820,40755] confirm A,B; C false and all false. Correct content SETS agree but no unique answer: potential only. K16-3/2036 contains1152 and49189 and is excluded.

After source restoration2021/29 has strict0<r<n and the same list-7,0,7,14 modulo7. Same other canonical-representative/congruence definitions and same SAI predicate. Complete false-content set is{exclusion of r=0,listing equal representatives as distinct classes}. Both lack a single key; potential only. Other lists(-6,1,8,15) or(-11,-4,3,10,17) are not merged.

Same modulus26,A=0 alphabet, explicit pairs19->9 and4->16, and complete option set{(3,4),(7,3),(3,7),(4,3)}. Independent solution is(3,4); displayed equation image in NMMMH/25 is redundant to these exact text pairs. AT17/6 changes a distractor to(4,2); K16-2/15 andK16-3/2022 change plaintext/ciphertext pairs and are excluded.

Same private sequence(12,17,33,64,137,326), W635,modulus737,exact permutation(3,6,1,2,5,4),public-key request and full four public-key tuple options. Independent tuple(319,650,250,477,29,105) matches after permutation; K16-3/2037's permutation(4,5,2,1,6,3) is excluded.

Same p31,q23,d223,m439,printed gcd(d,n)=1 and SAI predicate. After source correctionK16-2/22 verification exponent is367, not307. Full four propositions match: verify284^367 mod713,signatureS284,wrong public tuple(660,367) with private223,and secrecy of p,q,phi(n). Independent n713,e367,S284 establishes the common false public-key content. K16-3/2060 asks TRUE and changes exponent/secrecy statements, so is excluded.

Both ask which statement is TRUE. Full identical four-proposition set: confusion from permutation(false), Shannon's confusion+diffusion principles(true), diffusion from substitution(false), all-of-the-above(false). Only an explanatory comma differs in B; source spellings do not add a condition. Independent post-source theory gives complete(false,true,false,false) vectors and the same correct B content; both current keysB.

Both ask TRUE, with full A-D correspondenceABCD. A is public-key certification for recipient encryption/sender signing; B is establishing a shared secret between any two network participants; C is relatively long-lived community-wide TA-coordinated distribution; D is their conjunction. Differences are ky/ki,b at ky/ki typography and a comma before 'with coordination'; the longevity/community/TA and arbitrary-two-participant qualifiers are retained verbatim. Independent theory has the same incomplete(true,unknown,unknown,unknown) vectors and identical conditional aggregateD under course shorthand. Content is reviewed, but unique correct content is unproved, so potential only.

Both ask SAI and have exactly the same four group propositions: existence of a generator defines cyclic, ord(alpha)=phi(n) makes a generator in the unit group, ord(a) divides phi(n), and the false claim that a cyclic unit group has phi(n) generators. The domain Z_n* is retained; 'nhom' and 'Cho/N eu/Ta co' introductory words add no hypotheses. Mapping K16-2 A,B,C,D -> K16-3 B,D,A,C preserves every quantified condition. Independent group calculation/theory selects the generator-count claim (actual phi(phi(n))), with keysD andC matching content.
